keyEvents.text: Delay over. They are ready to continue.

Goal! Wrexham 0, Wolverhampton Wanderers 1. Adam Armstrong (Wolverhampton Wanderers) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Nasser Djiga with a through ball.
Goal! Wrexham 1, Wolverhampton Wanderers 1. Lewis O'Brien (Wrexham) header from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Issa Kaboré with a cross.
Toti Gomes (Wolverhampton Wanderers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Marshall Munetsi (Wolverhampton Wanderers).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Jacques Ekomié (Wrexham) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
André (Wolverhampton Wanderers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Wolverhampton Wanderers. Rafiki Saïd replaces Rodrigo Gomes.
Substitution, Wrexham. George Thomason replaces Oliver Rathbone.
Substitution, Wolverhampton Wanderers. Tommy Doyle replaces Mateus Mané.
Substitution, Wolverhampton Wanderers. Hugo Bueno replaces Toti Gomes.
Substitution, Wrexham. Bailey Cadamarteri replaces Kieffer Moore.
Substitution, Wrexham. Matty James replaces Benjamin Whiteman.
Substitution, Wrexham. Ben Sheaf replaces George Dobson.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
